mechanism: Brimonidine is an alpha-2 adrenergic agonist that may potentiate serotonergic effects and CNS depression when combined with sertraline, though systemic absorption from ophthalmic formulation is minimal.
action: Monitor for excessive sedation or CNS depression; ophthalmic brimonidine has low systemic bioavailability so clinical significance is minimal, but caution is warranted in sensitive patients.
